# Setup environment
exec privage init

# Create a source file with known content
cp input.txt secret.txt

# Add (encrypt) the file
exec privage add customcat secret.txt
stderr 'Added file'

# Verify the file exists in the list
exec privage list
stdout 'secret.txt'

# Rename the file
exec privage rename secret.txt renamed.txt
stderr 'Renamed'

# Verify the old name is gone and new name exists in the list
exec privage list
! stdout 'secret.txt'
stdout 'renamed.txt'

# Verify the content is preserved
exec privage cat renamed.txt
stdout 'secret data'

# Error case: Rename non-existent file
! exec privage rename missing.txt target.txt
stderr 'not found'

# Error case: Rename to existing file
exec privage add othercat other.txt
! exec privage rename renamed.txt other.txt
stderr 'already exists'

# Error case: Rename to same name
! exec privage rename renamed.txt renamed.txt
stderr 'identical'

-- input.txt --
secret data
-- other.txt --
other secret data
